options.content: **Workflow:** dla każdej liczby węzłów N ustaw unikalny `experiment_id` w panelu środowiska UI → uruchom symulację → porównaj runy na tym dashboardzie. Tag `node_count` pochodzi z `simulation_run` i jest kopiowany na metryki TX/RF.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "simulation_run")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "fading_sigma_db" or r._field == "shard_size" or r._field == "started")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "experiment_id", "node_count", "preset"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count", "preset"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
  |> count()
  |> group()

panels.title: Łączne TX OTA per eksperyment (vs node_count)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["node_count"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "rzeczywiste próby RF"}))

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "simulation_run")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["node_count"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      node_count: r.node_count,
      _field: "O(N²) referencja",
      _value: float(v: int(v: r.node_count)) * float(v: int(v: r.node_count)),
    }))
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count", "delivered"])
  |> count()
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["experiment_id", "node_count"], columnKey: ["delivered"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      experiment_id: r.experiment_id,
      node_count: r.node_count,
      _value: if exists r["True"] then float(v: r["True"]) / (float(v: r["True"]) + float(v: if exists r["False"] then r["False"] else 0)) * 100.0 else 0.0,
    }))
  |> group()

total =
  from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
    |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
    |> count()
    |> group()
    |> set(key: "kind", value: "total")

reb =
  from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "is_rebroadcast")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == true)
    |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
    |> count()
    |> group()
    |> set(key: "kind", value: "reb")

union(tables: [total, reb])
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count", "kind"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["experiment_id", "node_count"], columnKey: ["kind"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      experiment_id: r.experiment_id,
      node_count: r.node_count,
      _value: if exists r.total and r.total > 0 and exists r.reb then float(v: r.reb) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0 else 0.0,
    }))
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["tx_node"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

tx =
  from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
    |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
    |> count()
    |> group()
    |> set(key: "metric", value: "tx_total")

attempts =
  from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
    |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
    |> count()
    |> group()
    |> set(key: "metric", value: "rf_attempts")

delivered =
  from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.delivered == "True")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
    |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
    |> count()
    |> group()
    |> set(key: "metric", value: "rf_ok")

reb =
  from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "is_rebroadcast")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == true)
    |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
    |> count()
    |> group()
    |> set(key: "metric", value: "rebroadcasts")

union(tables: [tx, attempts, delivered, reb])
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count", "metric"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["experiment_id", "node_count"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["experiment_id", "node_count"], columnKey: ["metric"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      experiment_id: r.experiment_id,
      node_count: r.node_count,
      tx_total: r.tx_total,
      rf_attempts: r.rf_attempts,
      delivery_pct: if exists r.rf_attempts and r.rf_attempts > 0 and exists r.rf_ok then float(v: r.rf_ok) / float(v: r.rf_attempts) * 100.0 else 0.0,
      rebroadcast_pct: if exists r.tx_total and r.tx_total > 0 and exists r.rebroadcasts then float(v: r.rebroadcasts) / float(v: r.tx_total) * 100.0 else 0.0,
    }))
  |> group()
